auth.ctaSubtext: Sign in to start tracking your mastery.

landing.valueProp: Keep your accounts, devices, and readiness in one calm place — and build real confidence with the tech you rely on.

onboarding.title: Let's get you set up
onboarding.subtitle: A few quick steps to personalize your experience.
onboarding.goalSubtitle: Pick one. It just helps us point you in the right direction — you can do everything either way.

organize.title: Organize my accounts
organize.desc: See everything I have in one place.

prepare_device_loss.title: Be ready if I lose a device
prepare_device_loss.desc: Know what breaks if my phone or laptop is gone.

improve_security.title: Improve my account security
improve_security.desc: Find weak spots and fix the important ones.

understand_footprint.title: Understand my digital footprint
understand_footprint.desc: See where my logins and data live.

onboarding.areaSubtitle: Choose one life area to map your first account. You can add the rest later.
onboarding.firstAccountSubtitle: Just the basics — no passwords, ever. You can fill in details later.
onboarding.successTitle: You mapped your first account and one recovery dependency.
onboarding.successSubtitle: That's the whole idea. Keep going to see your map and readiness grow.

overview.subtitle: A calm overview of what you have and what to do next.
overview.emptyDesc: Add your first account to start seeing how everything connects.

map.title: Account map
map.subtitle: How your accounts, devices, and recovery paths connect.
map.hint: Pinch to zoom, drag to pan. Tap a node for details.
map.emptyDesc: Add an account and we'll draw how it connects to your devices and recovery paths.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.subtitle: Every account and device you've mapped.
inventory.emptyDesc: Start by adding the accounts and devices you use most.

accountForm.subtitle: Metadata only — never passwords or recovery codes.
accountForm.name: Account name
accountForm.backupCodesPlaceholder: e.g. printed at home, password manager
accountForm.keyFileLocationPlaceholder: e.g. only on my laptop, USB at home

readiness.title: Readiness
readiness.subtitle: Could you keep going if something failed? Here's where you stand.

levelMessage.notReady: A few important gaps. Nothing to panic about — let's close them one at a time.
levelMessage.inProgress: You're on your way. A couple of focused steps will make a real difference.
levelMessage.ready: You're in good shape. Mostly small refinements left.
levelMessage.mastered: You can rest easy — your important accounts are well covered.

account_protection.title: Account protection
account_protection.desc: Your important accounts have a second factor.

recovery_clarity.title: Recovery clarity
recovery_clarity.desc: You know how you'd get back into each account.

device_continuity.title: Device continuity
device_continuity.desc: Your devices are locked and findable.

backup_awareness.title: Backup awareness
backup_awareness.desc: Critical accounts have backup codes saved somewhere safe.

dependency_visibility.title: Dependency visibility
dependency_visibility.desc: You're not funneling everything through one account.

unresolved_unknowns.title: Open questions
unresolved_unknowns.desc: Fewer "not sure" answers across your accounts.

readiness.noActions: No actions right now — your map looks healthy.

enable_2fa.title: Turn on 2FA for {{name}}
enable_2fa.why: A second factor stops most account takeovers, even if a password leaks.

add_recovery.title: Set a recovery path for {{name}}
add_recovery.why: Without one, a lost password can mean losing the account for good.

save_backup_codes.title: Save backup codes for {{name}}
save_backup_codes.why: If you lose your phone, backup codes are often the only way back in.

reduce_google_dependency.title: Reduce how much depends on {{name}}
reduce_google_dependency.why: Many accounts recover or sign in through this one — if it's lost, a lot breaks at once.

set_device_lock.title: Add a screen lock to {{name}}
set_device_lock.why: A lock keeps your accounts safe if the device is lost or stolen.

resolve_unknown.title: Fill in the unknowns for {{name}}
resolve_unknown.why: Knowing how you log in and recover is the first step to protecting it.

sim.title: Simulations
sim.subtitle: Play out a worst case before it happens. "What breaks if…"

email_locked.question: What breaks if I can't get into my main email?

card_stolen.question: What breaks if my card details are stolen?
